The '''Revolution''' was a [[wheel bike]] produced by [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing]] during or after the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Koensayr Revolution was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as one of the items in the Anarchist's Alliance Pack.
